notes.title: DreamBack VR | Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]DreamBack VR[/b] by [b]Come Over Gaming[/b] will be released on June 10th for $24.99 on Steam VR, with a launch discount of a 10% off. 

[previewyoutube=YCveG4ApBrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Try to unravel the mysteries of the eerie Rickfford Mansion without losing your sanity in pure terror. 
A first-person psychological horror game in VR by Come Over Gaming.

[b]Wishlist and follow:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/923230/DreamBack_VR/
